title: 第391章 你敢伤害他！
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

香香的大脑一片空白。

那怪物夺舍自己不成…小灵儿成了自己的替代品。

小灵儿死了…小灵儿被自己害死了……

这一句句话，像是一柄生了锈的钝刀，一下一下地剜着她的心脏。

连那缺了半块心脏的剧痛，都被深深的愧疚感盖了过去。

走神之际。

小灵儿的身影突然消失在了原地，香香身侧空气中，一道漆黑色狐爪无声无息而来，角度刁钻的直击她胸口处的大血洞。

速度快到了极致！

待香香反应过来时，黑色狐爪已临近伤口。

她猛然抬眸，身体带着几分僵硬地退后两步，同时左手幻化成白色狐爪迎了上去。

狐爪碰撞，二人齐齐色变。

噗！！！

香香娇躯剧颤，被一股巨力震飞出去，重重砸倒在地。

碰撞之下，心脏伤口处涌出的鲜血越来越多，体内的灵力也飞速流失，整个人虚弱到了极点……

帝狐死死锁定着狐祖手令。

“此物，竟能压制本帝两个大境界？！”

“区区大天尊境，居然能与准帝巅峰抗衡，此等神物，本帝闻所未闻！”

她眼底闪过一抹深深的贪婪。

香香脸色惨白，神情恍惚。

准帝巅峰这几个字，让她的心凉透了……

她本想借着狐祖手令与对方周旋，但对方不仅是准帝，更是达到了准帝境巅峰。

她如今是大天尊境巅峰，距离准帝巅峰之间，刚好差了两个大境界。

但缺了半颗心脏，她的身体已漏如筛子，实力早不复之前……

“小灵儿不能白死。”

复仇意志强撑着香香艰难站起来。

但身体一用力，口中和心脏伤口处齐齐涌出鲜血……

帝狐神色讥讽。

瞳孔中的重瞳诡异旋转着，宛如漆黑色漩涡的重瞳中，有两道黑光嗖嗖射出，精准落在了香香的身上。

后者娇躯一僵，直接被定在了原地！

“蝼蚁。”

帝狐步步朝香香走来，浑身充斥着霸道的神魔之力。

“如果本帝是你的话，早已无颜活在这世上，为了自己苟活而害了姐妹性命，你还有活着的资格吗？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Xiangxiang's mind went blank.

That monster couldn't take away his body... Xiao Ling'er became his substitute.

Xiao Ling'er is dead... Xiao Ling'er was killed by herself...

This sentence was like a dull, rusty knife, gouging out her heart one by one.

Even the severe pain of missing half of his heart was overshadowed by a deep sense of guilt.

When the mind wanders.

Xiao Ling'er's figure suddenly disappeared, and in the air beside Xiangxiang, a jet-black fox claw came silently, hitting the big blood hole in her chest at a tricky angle.

The speed is extremely fast!

When Xiangxiang reacted, the black fox claw was close to the wound.

She suddenly raised her eyes, and took two steps back with a bit of stiffness. At the same time, her left hand turned into a white fox claw and came forward.

The fox claws collided, and both of them changed their expressions.

puff!!!

Xiangxiang's delicate body trembled violently, and she was thrown away by a huge force and fell heavily to the ground.

Under the collision, more and more blood gushed out from the heart wound, and the spiritual energy in the body was rapidly lost. The whole person was extremely weak...

Emperor Fox locked onto the Fox Ancestor's warrant.

"This thing can actually suppress the two great realms of this emperor?!"

"A mere Great Heavenly Lord can actually compete with the pinnacle of the Quasi-Emperor. This kind of divine object has never been heard of by this Emperor!"

A deep greed flashed in her eyes.

Xiangxiang's face was pale and she was in a daze.

The words "quasi-emperor peak" made her heart freeze...

She originally wanted to use the Fox Ancestor's order to deal with the opponent, but the opponent was not only a quasi-emperor, but also reached the peak of the quasi-emperor realm.

She is now at the peak of the Great Heavenly Realm, just two realms away from the peak of the Quasi-Emperor.

But without half of her heart, her body was as leaky as a sieve, and her strength was no longer what it was before...

"Little Ling'er can't die in vain."

With a strong will for revenge, Xiangxiang stood up with difficulty.

But as soon as the body exerted force, blood gushed out from the mouth and heart wound...

The Emperor Fox looked sarcastic.

The double pupils in the pupils were spinning strangely, and from the double pupils like a pitch-black whirlpool, two black lights shot out and landed accurately on Xiangxiang's body.

The latter's delicate body froze and was immediately frozen in place!

"Ant."

Emperor Fox walked towards Xiangxiang step by step, his whole body filled with the power of domineering gods and demons.

"If this emperor were you, you would have no shame in living in this world, and you would kill your sisters just to survive. Do you still have the right to live?"
